title: Cross-cultural Adaptation and Validation of the Localised Scleroderma Quality of Life Instrument (LoSQI) in Juvenile Localised Scleroderma (JLS)
off: Cross-cultural Adaptation and Validation of the Localised Scleroderma Quality of Life Instrument (LoSQI) in Juvenile Localised Scleroderma (JLS): a Multicentre Study of the PRES Scleroderma Working Party in Collaboration With Members of the CARRA Scleroderma Working Group
summary:
This international study adapts and validates the Localised Scleroderma Quality of Life Instrument (LoSQI) for children with JLS, a rare condition causing hardened skin and tissue.

Goals \& Methods:

Workstream 1: Translates and culturally adapts LoSQI for multi-national use, pre-testing it with patients and families.

Workstream 2: Validates the tool through a prospective study of at least 100 patients across global centers (PRINTO, CARRA, PRES).

Impact: It creates the first multi-national, disease-specific Patient-Reported Outcome (PRO) for JLS, helping researchers combine global data and embedding quality-of-life tracking into routine clinical care.
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 8-18 years with JLS diagnosed by a paediatric rheumatologist
* Understanding of written native language to level of 8 years old child
* Willing to consent/assent to the study
* Parent willing to consent in those under 16 years of age.

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Any co-morbidity not related to JLS or its complications which may impact on PRO.
